claims.statement: Finite Der interpretation consumes explicit realizers of used global/local assumptions; no whole-HoTT reflection.
Proof-producing macro expansion yields a base derivation in the target environment; conservative on this object fragment.
Bridges to all source axioms iff a uniform all-formula proof transfer; mutual implication only, not inverse proof-level equivalence.
Used-axiom bridges suffice for a given derivation, but their absence is not a no-proof theorem for its conclusion.
Changing permit:P to permit:Q does not preserve a proof of P; target Q model with P empty separates them.
Shared Agda file is uncompiled; Python parser to Der correspondence not proved in a native kernel.
No assertion that standard HoTT or deployed Agda uses the deliberately unsafe receipt-only policy.
